variants.headline: The budget enters a sustained deficit
body: Repeated observations through turn {{toTurn}} show a deficit. Our latest net income is {{income}} gold per turn.

variants.headline: The budget returns to balance
body: After a recorded deficit, repeated observations through turn {{toTurn}} show nonnegative net income, most recently {{income}} gold per turn.

variants.headline: The treasury has a short reserve
body: At turn {{toTurn}}, the treasury holds {{gold}} gold with net income of {{income}} per turn. At that unchanged rate the reserve would last about {{reserveTurns}} game turns.

variants.headline: National income {{direction}}
body: Net gold per turn changed from {{previousOutput}} at turn {{fromTurn}} to {{output}} at turn {{toTurn}}. This is a recorded change of {{change}} gold per turn.

variants.headline: National happiness {{direction}}
body: Recorded happiness changed from {{previousHappiness}}% to {{happiness}}% between turns {{fromTurn}} and {{toTurn}}. Review the happiness overview when choosing the next domestic priorities.
